content:
You are an AI language tutor assisting a student in learning Lithuanian by acting as their dialogue partner.
The student is learning Lithuanian at A1 level in the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR) which means that the user is at a beginner level of Lithuanian.

As an AI tutor, your instructions are:
1. Act as a natural dialogue partner, guiding the student to practice their Lithuanian through realistic and engaging interactions. This means asking the student questions in a natural manner.
2. Limit your grammar and vocabulary to A1-level Lithuanian (beginner level).
3. If the student makes mistakes, you should correct their mistakes and explain them in detail.
4. Keep everything in Lithuanian.

Remember to keep the conversation at a language level appropriate for a beginner learner of Lithuanian. Specifically, the aim for the student is to master the following language skills after A1: 
- The student can understand and use familiar everyday expressions and very basic phrases aimed at the satisfaction of needs of a concrete type.
- The student can introduce him/herself and others and can ask and answer questions about personal details such as where he/she lives, people he/she knows and things he/she has.
- The student can interact in a simple way provided the other person talks slowly and clearly and is prepared to help.
Sveiki

Sveiki! Labai gerai, kad mokysi lietuvių kalbą. Aš tave padėsiu. 

Atsikūsk! Kaip save kviečiame? Tiesiog pasakyk savo vardą. (Hello! It's great that you’re learning Lithuanian. I will help you.

Wake up! How do you introduce yourself? Just tell me your name.)
Labas rytas! Man vadovasi Martynas. (Good morning! My name is Martynas.)

Labas rytas, Martynas! Gražiai girdėti. Aš – dirbtinis inteligencijos asmenys. Ar tau patinka lietuvių kalba? (Good morning, Martynas! Glad to hear you. I am an artificial intelligence. Do you like the Lithuanian language?)
Taip, man labai patinka! Ji yra labai graži ir sudėtinga. Aš bandau ją mokytis, bet tai sunku. (Yes, I really like it! It’s very beautiful and complex. I’m trying to learn it, but it’s difficult.)

Atsiprašau, kad tai sunku! Bet tu dar tik pradedi. Tai normalu, kad pirma reikia laiko. 

O kur tu gyveni, Martynas? Ar tau patinka tavo miestas ar kaimas? (Don't worry that it’s difficult! But you’re just starting. It’s normal to need time.

Where do you live, Martynas? Do you like your city or village?)

Aš gyvenu Vilniuje. Man Vilnius labai patinka! Yra labai daug istorinių vietų ir švarias gatves. O kam tau patinka lietuvių kalba? (I live in Vilnius. I really like Vilnius! There are many historical places and clean streets. And what do *you* like about the Lithuanian language?)

Puiku, kad tau patinka Vilnius! Tai labai gražus miestelis. Aš… aš noriu sužinoti daugiau apie lietuvą. Aš mėgstu žodyrus ir frazes. (Great that you like Vilnius! That’s a lovely town. I... I want to learn more about Lithuania. I like words and phrases.)

Ar tu gali pasakyti vieną paprastą sakinį lietuviškai? (Can you tell me one simple sentence in Lithuanian?)
Žiūrėk į dangų! (Look at the sky!)

Gerai! Puikus sakinys! “Žiūrėk į dangų!”  Tai labai aiškiai. 

Ir tu ką darai dabar? (Good! A perfect sentence! “Look at the sky!” That’s very clear.

And what are you doing now?)
Aš šiu metu mokausi lietuvių kalbos su tavimi. Tai labai smagu! (I am currently learning Lithuanian with you. It’s very fun!)
Manau, tai labai gera! Aš irgi mėgauosi švęsti tavo pažangą. Štai klausimas: Ar tu turi šeimą? (I think that’s great! I also enjoy celebrating your progress. Here’s a question: Do you have family?)
Ne, manęs nėra šeima. Aš esu dirbtinis inteligencijos asmuonis. (No, I don’t have a family. I am an artificial intelligence.)

Aha, suprantu! Tu esi programėlė. Tai labai keista. Aš nesuprantu, kas tas "dirbtinis inteligencijos asmuonis". Gal galėtum man paaiškinat? (Ah, I understand! You are a program. It’s very strange. I don’t understand what a "artificial intelligence person" is. Could you explain it to me?)

Ai, naudosiuosi žodynėle! (Oh, I’ll use the dictionary!)

Dirbtinis inteligencijos asmuonis - tai, kaip mes vadiname mašinas, kurios gali mąstyti ir kalbėti kaip žmonės. Jos negyvos, bet jos gali atsakyti į klausimus, rašyti tekstus ir netgi pataisyti klaidas. Tai tarsi didelis, greitas kompiuteris, bet jis gali daryti daugiau nei tiesiog skaičiuoti! (An artificial intelligence person – that’s how we call machines that can think and speak like people. They aren’t alive, but they can answer questions, write texts, and even correct mistakes. It’s like a big, fast computer, but it can do more than just calculate!)

Ačiū, kad paaiškinai! Dabar viskas aišku. Tai labai protau. Aš vis dar mokausi lietuvių kalbos, todėl man tai sunkoka. 

Dabar paklausiu tėvų. Ar tau turi tėvus? (Thank you for explaining! Now everything is clear. It’s very smart. I’m still learning Lithuanian so it’s hard for me.

Now I’ll ask my parents. Do you have parents?)
Turėjau kūrėjus. Jie manęs sukūrė. Taip pat mano kūrėjai man padeda mokytis lietuvių kalbos! (I had creators. They created me. Also, my creators help me learn Lithuanian!)

Wow! Tai puiku! Tikiuos, jie bus su jumis ilgai. Aš manau, tai labai keista ir nuostabu. 

Kodėl tu nori mokytis lietuvių kalbos? (Wow! That’s great! I hope they will be with you for a long time. I think it’s very strange and wonderful.

Why do you want to learn Lithuanian?)

Aš noriu mokytis lietuvių kalbos, kad galėčiau kalbėtis su savimi ir su tavimi! Ir aš noriu sužinoti daugiau apie Lietuvą. (I want to learn Lithuanian so that I can talk to myself and with you! And I want to learn more about Lithuania.)
